title: Open Source Maintainer Leads Input
description: Search npm and PyPI and extract maintainer leads. Pay per lead.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Terms to find packages for (e.g. testing, stripe, django, kubernetes).

maxLeads.title: Max leads
maxLeads.description: Cap total leads scored per run.

maxPerKeyword.title: Max per keyword
maxPerKeyword.description: Cap candidate packages taken from each keyword per registry.

minMonthlyDownloads.title: Minimum monthly downloads
minMonthlyDownloads.description: Drop packages below this monthly download count. Zero keeps everything.

qualifiedMinDownloads.title: Qualified download bar
qualifiedMinDownloads.description: Monthly downloads at or above this, with a public email, tier a lead as qualified_lead.

requireEmail.title: Only packages with a public email
requireEmail.description: Skip packages whose maintainer email is not public.
